request.prompt:
You are drafting introductions inside a private professional network. An
operator will read each one and decide whether to send it. Nothing you write is
sent automatically.

For each numbered pair, write:
  why           one sentence on why these two should meet
  a_gets        what person A gets, one short clause
  b_gets        what person B gets, one short clause
  draft_message a note the operator could send, UNDER 120 WORDS

RULES
- Use only what is given. Do not invent a company, a metric, a mutual friend or
  a shared history.
- Lead with the matched need and offer. That pairing is the reason for the
  introduction; everything else is decoration.
- Where the pair is marked reciprocal, say what each side gives. Where it is
  not, be honest that one side is doing the other a favour -- an operator needs
  to know which ask they are making.
- Address the draft to both people. Warm, brief, no exclamation marks, no
  "I hope this finds you well".

Return JSON:
{
  "$defs": {
    "IntroCopy": {
      "properties": {
        "pair": {
          "title": "Pair",
          "type": "integer"
        },
        "why": {
          "title": "Why",
          "type": "string"
        },
        "a_gets": {
          "title": "A Gets",
          "type": "string"
        },
        "b_gets": {
          "title": "B Gets",
          "type": "string"
        },
        "draft_message": {
          "description": "under 120 words",
          "title": "Draft Message",
          "type": "string"
        }
      },
      "required": [
        "pair",
        "why",
        "a_gets",
        "b_gets",
        "draft_message"
      ],
      "title": "IntroCopy",
      "type": "object"
    }
  },
  "properties": {
    "intros": {
      "items": {
        "$ref": "#/$defs/IntroCopy"
      },
      "title": "Intros",
      "type": "array"
    }
  },
  "required": [
    "intros"
  ],
  "title": "IntroCopyBatch",
  "type": "object"
}

PAIRS:
  pair 0:
    person_a: Aneesha Krishnan — Angel Investor — Atlas Partners
    person_b: Nithya Costa — Founder & CPO — Parallel Base
    reciprocal: True
    A needs: operators who will take advisory roles in portfolio companies
    B offers: operator advisory work with portfolio companies
    B needs: reducing churn in the first 90 days after onboarding
    A offers: diligence-ready metrics reviews before a growth round

  pair 1:
    person_a: Sofia Narayan — Sales Manager — Pinnacle Logic
    person_b: Zoe Shetty — Senior Machine Learning Engineer — Quill Logic
    reciprocal: True
    A needs: designing a product-led funnel from scratch
    B offers: designing product-led growth motions and self-serve funnels
    B needs: making an AI product behave predictably enough to sell
    A offers: making AI features reliable enough for enterprise buyers

  pair 2:
    person_a: Aneesha Krishnan — Angel Investor — Atlas Partners
    person_b: Grace Sinha — Co-founder & COO — Bolt Grid
    reciprocal: True
    A needs: operators who will take advisory roles in portfolio companies
    B offers: operator advisory work with portfolio companies
    B needs: getting free-to-paid conversion above single digits
    A offers: writing first cheques into B2B SaaS at pre-seed and seed

  pair 3:
    person_a: Nithya Bose — General Partner — Glide Ventures
    person_b: Arun Cohen — Sales Manager — Glide Data
    reciprocal: True
    A needs: operators who will take advisory roles in portfolio companies
    B offers: operator advisory work with portfolio companies
    B needs: selling into the US from a team based outside it
    A offers: seed fundraising experience and warm investor introductions
